scope: Unadopted folded auricle geometry and eye material; not full naturalism or production acceptance

findings: Auricle shell, helix, antihelix, concha and tragus replace overlapping oval ears; saved size/shape scale each component.
Mirrored shell/cartilage normals face outward. Smaller tessellation retains the existing mesh payload limit.
Eye material uses camera-consistent corneal normals, lid shadow and localized wet reflection. It remains a material approximation on the shared facial surface, not separate observed eyeball anatomy.
Small ear detail and eye reflections remain limited at normal display size. Full adult faces, cap-like hair, sparse locks and painted beard remain below the art target.
